descriptionHtml:
Approach · TC-13 Previous Notes · S03 Photograph a prior note: the read text lands in the box for review with every value as printed

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • T4 A photographed prior note is read by Google Gemini Flash via Vertex AI. The prototype's photo-reading instruction text is used word for word with only the request format adapted, and the read text ke … (TFA-94425 AC 1; TFA-94425 AC 2; TFA-94425 AC 3; TFA-94425 AC 4)

Test design technique: Happy path (happy-path) — Walk the normal flow exactly as the UAT / ticket words it; everything it names has to show up.

Given Fresh physician with the fixture Hospital patient; live Vertex photo read (Gemini Flash) on the local stack. The read is never mocked here, because a mocked read tests nothing of T4

When Previous Notes → Photograph → upload the synthetic note image, wait until the button no longer says Reading, and save the checkpoint without pressing anything else

Then The read text sits in the note box for review, with every value exactly as printed (BP 142/88, creatinine 1.1, BNP 1250, EF 30%). A misread value (1.1 → 7.1) is a Fail of T4

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): oracle.mjs on s03-read: mustContain the printed facts and values ('pleural effusion', 'creatinine 1.1', 'BNP 1250', 'EF 30%', '142/88'; vitals belong in the box and are kept off the chart only), and mustNotContain {snfResident}. Only the photo read (TFA-94425, ready for qa) is judged here, so the only requirement is T4. …

Where it ran: dev unit U76; test method AGENT · Browser agent; lane planned in the matrix: browser agent (blocked)

S03 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-13.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Environment: dev — dev deployment, build 43c38a4 (Deploy Convex, 2026-10-14T21:30:04Z); account and address are not written into the report; run folder runs/2026-10-14-dev.

Test method: AGENT · Browser agent; secondary: AICHECK · AI output check — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on both; Source: dev.
